episodes.title: Taste of the King
episodes.summary: The simulator lands Clancy on a zombie-ravaged earth, where he meets the president, who's a fan of drugs and meditation.

episodes.title: Officers and Wolves
episodes.summary: On a planet populated by baby clowns, Clancy hears a deer-dog's thoughts on death as they head to a slaughterhouse.

episodes.title: Hunters Without a Home
episodes.summary: Clancy zaps to an underwater planet, where he crosses paths with Darryl, a student of ceremonial magic and the path to enlightenment.

episodes.title: Blinded By My End
episodes.summary: A mishap sends Clancy to a medieval planet, where he rides along with a knight on a mission to avenge her lover's murder.

episodes.title: Annihilation of Joy
episodes.summary: At a prison for simulated beings suffering from existential dread, Clancy ponders reality as he watches an inmate perish over and over.

episodes.title: Vulture With Honor
episodes.summary: When his simulator malfunctions, Clancy is forced to face a few real-world problems. Later, he meets a meditation master.

episodes.title: Turtles of the Eclipse
episodes.summary: A boring trip takes a remarkable turn when Clancy accidentally falls into another world — and comes face to face with Death.

episodes.title: Mouse of Silver
episodes.summary: Clancy joins his mother on an emotional journey through the wondrous cycle of birth, life and death.
